>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/location-imports"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The bootstrap mechanism: takes a JSON array of fully-specified rows (a site/area/zone/aisle/bay/level/position address plus a LocationType) and loads a real warehouse's layout in one reproducible call, creating the Site, Zone and Aisle structure on first sight. A row naming structure that already exists reuses it and never mutates it, so an import cannot silently redefine a zone's temperature class.

Validation is **atomic per row** with partial success reported per row: every row is processed, and the report says exactly which rows failed and why. A 500-row export with 3 bad rows still creates the other 497.

This answers 200 OK, not 201: a bulk import is a partial-success report over many rows, not the creation of one addressable resource, so there is no single Location to hand back. Publishes one FacilityLayoutImported carrying the counts, plus the usual per-entity registration events as structure is created.

The import is a batch-job noun (`/location-imports`, REST API guideline 1.3 e) and is idempotent: a retry with the same Idempotency-Key replays the stored report with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` instead of importing twice.

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"description":"Caller-generated key (a UUID per logical submit, 1-128 printable ASCII characters) that makes a retried POST safe (ADR 0019, ADR 0044). Clients MUST always send it: the service runs on Postgres in every deployment (ADR 0039), so the header is always enforced and an absent key is answered 400 `idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one 400 `idempotency-key-invalid`. A replay with the same key, method, path and body returns the original response verbatim plus the response header `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. The key is global (not per route).","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128,"example":"5b0f6a0e-6a41-4c63-9f33-0c8f5c1d2a77"}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
